## Sandy Brondello suspended over Angel Reese remark

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/34a8d349-3838-4370-a6de-a2c33c44c4d6/USATSI_29185378_168398024_lowres__1_.jpg?t=1784553606) [Toronto Tempo head coach Sandy Brondello watches from the sidelines during the first half against the Washington Mystics at CareFirst Arena.]
Caption: Tempo coach Sandy Brondello drew a one-game suspension for calling Angel Reese a ‘protected species’ during Friday’s loss to Atlanta. (Emily Faith Morgan/Imagn Images)

**The WNBA made a statement on Saturday, **issuing No. 10 Toronto coach Sandy Brondello a one-game unpaid suspension for calling Atlanta’s Angel Reese a [“protected species”](https://sports.yahoo.com/wnba/article/tempo-coach-sandy-brondello-suspended-1-game-by-wnba-for-protected-species-remark-about-angel-reese-174917502.html) in Friday’s 111-92 loss to the No. 5 Dream.
